name: Harmonies
metaDescription: Free Harmonies score calculator for 1–4 players. Scores trees, mountains, fields, buildings, rivers or islands, animal cards and nature's spirits.
intro: Harmonies scores five kinds of landscape plus your animal cards. Count trees and mountains by height, measure your river and the calculator does the rest.

categories.label: Trees
categories.help: A green token on top of 0, 1 or 2 brown trunk tokens.

categories.label: Mountains
categories.help: Stacks of grey tokens. A mountain only scores if it is next to another mountain.

categories.label: Fields
categories.help: Each group of 2 or more touching yellow tokens scores 5, however big it is.

categories.label: Buildings
categories.help: A red building scores 5 if at least 3 different colours surround it (top tokens only).

categories.label: Longest river (side A)
categories.help: Count tokens along the shortest path from one end of your best river to the other.

categories.label: Animal cards
categories.help: For each card, score the number in the highest space without a cube. Cards with every cube still on them score 0.

expansions.name: Side B boards (islands)
expansions.description: Water scores 5 per island instead of rivers.

categories.label: Islands (side B)
categories.help: Each area of land separated from the rest by water is an island worth 5. You always have at least 1.

expansions.name: Nature's Spirit cards
expansions.description: Adds the points from your spirit card.

categories.label: Nature's spirit
categories.help: Points from your nature's spirit card, scored like an animal card.

tiebreaker: If players are tied, the one who has placed the most animal cubes wins. If still tied, they share the victory.

rules.heading: When Harmonies ends
body: The game ends when the pouch cannot refill the central board, or when a player has two or fewer empty spaces on their board. Finish the round so everyone has had the same number of turns, then score landscapes and animal cards.

rules.heading: Scoring landscapes
body: Trees score by height: a green token alone is 1 point, on one brown trunk 3 points and on two trunks 7 points. Mountains score the same 1, 3 or 7 by height, but only when the mountain is next to at least one other mountain.
Each field of two or more touching yellow tokens scores 5 points, whatever its size. A building scores 5 points when the top tokens around it show at least three different colours.

rules.heading: Water: rivers or islands
body: On side A you score only your best river, measured along the shortest path from one end to the other: 2 points for 2 tokens, 5 for 3, 8 for 4, 11 for 5 and 15 for 6, plus 4 for every token beyond the sixth.
On side B, water splits your land into islands, and each island scores 5 points. You always have at least one island.

rules.heading: Animal cards
body: For every animal card, finished or not, score the number shown in the highest space that no longer has a cube. A card that still has all its cubes scores nothing, but there is no penalty for unfinished cards.

faq.q: Do unfinished animal cards score in Harmonies?
faq.a: Yes. Score the highest uncovered number. Only a card with all its cubes still on it scores 0.
A mountain must be next to another mountain to score.

faq.q: How are ties broken in Harmonies?
faq.a: The player who placed the most animal cubes wins. If still tied, players share the victory.
